DHAKA, Oct 30, 2022 (BSS) - Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BGMEA) today said the export earnings target from readymade garments set by the government for the FY23 is unlikely to be achieved due to the high inflation in major markets and shortage of energy in the country.

"Export earnings target from RMG for the current fiscal year will not be achieved as global buyers have been placing the decreasing volume of orders due to inflation," BGMEA President Faruque Hassan
